environment.description: Deployed on ECS Fargate task with task role arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/ws-service-task. Container runs as non-root UID 10001 with readOnlyRootFilesystem:true. An EFS volume is mounted at /var/app/uploads with uid/gid mapping enforced via EFS access point (ap-0a1b2c3d4e5f) restricting writes to /var/app/uploads/** only (POSIX ACL enforcement at mount level, no parent traversal possible). The PostgreSQL 15.4 connection string references role 'ws_reader' configured with: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO ws_reader; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO ws_reader; no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE granted. pg_hba.conf restricts ws_reader connections to the Fargate subnet CIDR only. Additionally, the ECS task definition sets linuxParameters.capabilities.drop=[ALL] and the container has no CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE.
